title: CoinRun tokenizer v2 complete five-scale reconstruction sweep
question: How do held-out global, edge and temporal-change reconstruction metrics change across five CoinRun tokenizer scales that retain the fixed latent interface required by dynamics?
reason: CR-DEMO-0001 was technically runnable but visually unusable. Its 0.17M tokenizer reached only 24.2447 dB held-out EMA clean PSNR and visibly lost small sprites and platform edges, so dynamics scaling must pause until the representation bottleneck is improved.
hypothesis: Scaling the tokenizer backbone while holding the latent interface, data and evaluation protocol fixed will improve full-frame and detail-sensitive reconstruction through at least one of the larger scales.
falsification: The hypothesis is rejected if the complete five-scale sweep shows no reproducible full-frame, edge or temporal-change improvement over the fresh 0.17M arm, or if the larger tokenizers cannot preserve the 16-latent by 16-channel interface needed by dynamics.

data.policy: 65% goal-directed persistent right/right-jump/no-op macros mixed with 35% balanced persistent left/left-jump/no-op/jump/right/right-jump macros

compute.estimated_budget: 9e16 FLOPs total: 1e16 for each of n0.17m, n1.1m and n3.7m; 2e16 for n8.6m; 4e16 for n16.6m
compute.shutdown_policy: A bounded shutdown timer is created before launch; a monitor stops the existing instance after terminal artifacts are synchronized.

evaluation.visual_artifact: one retained reconstruction grid per scale plus a vertically aligned comparison grid

success_criteria.rule: All five arms complete their declared from-scratch FLOPs allocations and produce finite held-out metrics on the identical 512 clips.
Report the complete scale curve for EMA clean, masked, edge and temporal-change PSNR without using any threshold to stop or skip a scale.
Train n8.6m at 2e16 FLOPs and n16.6m at 4e16 FLOPs unconditionally after the first three arms.
The selected candidate must retain n_latents=16 and d_bottleneck=16 and later pass a joint tokenizer-plus-medium-dynamics one-step A10 smoke before dynamics training is authorized.
Automatic ranking is descriptive only: dynamics remains blocked until the aligned five-scale reconstruction grid receives explicit visual acceptance for player outline and platform-edge clarity.
